question: On the source-pinned [[72,12,6]] BB code under independent X-only code-capacity noise, how do compatible BP updates and two BP-internal interventions change unconditional valid-recovery probability and measured work under a shared edge-message cap?
claim_scope: Controlled CSS adaptation on BB72; no Bravyi circuit-level, BPGD source-curve, or BP-SF source-curve reproduction claim.

shared_work.other_work: Retain and report all typed non-message work, BP calls, wall time, and resource context separately; the edge cap is not equal total CPU cost.

selection_rule.unit: one decoder family across all three selection rates
selection_rule.selected_for_evaluation: one configuration per family plus fixed SPA gamma=1 reference

assessment.primary_endpoint: unconditional_failure = any terminal outcome other than exact or stabilizer_equivalent
assessment.contrasts: each selected family versus the fixed reference at each rate
assessment.paired_test: two-sided exact McNemar via binomial test on discordant matched samples
assessment.multiplicity: Holm familywise adjustment over all non-reference family-by-rate contrasts
assessment.rate_interval: two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson interval on all terminal samples
assessment.paired_effect_power_status: No minimum detectable paired effect is guaranteed by 512 shots; nonsignificant contrasts remain inconclusive.
assessment.decision_rule: Report a directional difference only when adjusted p <= 0.05 and the observed difference has that direction; otherwise inconclusive. No decoder ranking follows from a single code or noise model.

source_settings_view.source: Bravyi et al., arXiv:2308.07915 and sbravyi/BivariateBicycleCodes@fa77e333
source_settings_view.reason: The pinned source uses circuit-level BP-OSD; this study has perfect-syndrome X-only CSS noise and BP-only arms.

source_settings_view.source: Yao et al., arXiv:2312.10950v2, Algorithm 1 and B1 simulations
source_settings_view.reason: The controlled BB72 arm uses T=5 and R=8 under the common cap; the B1 source reports T=10 or 100 and a larger decimation envelope.

source_settings_view.source: Gokduman, Yao and Pfister, arXiv:2411.08177v2, Eq. 17
source_settings_view.reason: The same V2C recurrence is used on an X-bit-flip channel with project-selected gamma values; published erasure-channel optimized gamma values are not imported.
Seeded stable test order and first-valid original-problem selection replace source unseeded parallel arrival semantics.
